A plain autoencoder has a @@T0@@continuo.zh:
一个朴素的自编码器具有@@T0@@连续的@@T1@@潜变量—空间中任何一点都是合法的。
      VQ-VAE 则维护一个由 $K$ 个向量构成的、小的已学习@@T2@@码本@@T3@@，并强制
      每一次编码都吸附到与之最近的条目。潜变量因此变为@@T4@@离散的@@T5@@：一个
      查表的索引。拖动下方的编码点，观察它跳向最近的码；
      拖动各个码，观察它们各自的领地—即 Voronoi 单元—如何重绘。
A plain autoencoder has a @@T0@@continuo.src: A plain autoencoder has a continuous latent — any point in space is legal. VQ-VAE instead keeps a small learned codebook of $K$ vectors and forces every encoding to snap to its nearest entry. The latent becomes discrete: an index into a lookup table. Drag the encoding point below and watch it jump to the closest code; drag the codes and watch their territories — the Voronoi cells — redraw.

@@T0@@~8 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Lea.zh:
@@T0@@约 8 分钟@@T1@@
      @@T2@@深度学习 · 生成模型 · 离散潜变量@@T3@@
@@T0@@~8 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Deep Lea.src: ~8 min Deep Learning · Generative Models · Discrete Latents

One continuous vector becomes one intege.zh: 一个连续向量变成一个整数
One continuous vector becomes one intege.src: One continuous vector becomes one integer

The encoder produces a continuous vector.zh:
编码器产生一个连续向量 $z \in \mathbb{R}^d$。向量量化把它
      替换为 $K$ 个已学习的码向量 $e_1, \dots, e_K$（即码本）中最近的一个：
The encoder produces a continuous vector.src:
The encoder produces a continuous vector $z \in \mathbb{R}^d$. Vector quantization replaces
      it with the nearest of $K$ learned code vectors $e_1, \dots, e_K$ (the codebook):

The decoder then works from $z_q$ alone,.zh:
随后解码器仅依据 $z_q$ 工作，因此它接收到的永远只是 $K$ 个可能向量中的
      一个—等价地说，就是单个整数 $k^{\star}$。最近邻分配
      把平面切割成@@T0@@Voronoi 单元@@T1@@：同一单元中的每一点共享同一个
      最近的码。量化不过是：@@T2@@$z$ 落在了哪一个单元里？@@T3@@
The decoder then works from $z_q$ alone,.src: The decoder then works from $z_q$ alone, so all it ever receives is one of $K$ possible vectors — equivalently, the single integer $k^{\star}$. Nearest-neighbour assignment carves the plane into Voronoi cells: every point in a cell shares the same closest code. Quantization is just: which cell did $z$ land in?

The coloured regions are the Voronoi cel.zh:
彩色区域是码本的 Voronoi 单元；带环的大点是
      码向量 $e_k$。深色@@T0@@菱形是编码 $z$@@T1@@ —
      @@T2@@把它拖到@@T3@@任意位置，箭头便显示它吸附到 $z_q$，即拥有
      它所处单元的那个码。@@T4@@拖动各个码@@T5@@ 以移动单元边界。点击
      @@T6@@量化一片点云@@T7@@ 以投放一批编码，并按每个编码被分配到的码
      为其着色。
The coloured regions are the Voronoi cel.src: The coloured regions are the Voronoi cells of the codebook; the large ringed dots are the code vectors $e_k$. The dark diamond is the encoding $z$ — drag it anywhere and the arrow shows it snapping to $z_q$, the code owning whatever cell it is in. Drag the codes to move the cell boundaries. Hit Quantize a cloud to drop a batch of encodings and colour each by the code it is assigned to.

Drag the dark diamond ($z$) or any ringe.zh:
拖动深色菱形（$z$）或任意带环的码（$e_k$）。箭头从 $z$ 指向它的
        量化值 $z_q$ —即最近的码。切换点云可看到一整批
        被一次性分配。
Drag the dark diamond ($z$) or any ringe.src:
Drag the dark diamond ($z$) or any ringed code ($e_k$). The arrow points from $z$ to its
        quantized value $z_q$ — the nearest code. Toggle the cloud to see a whole batch
        assigned at once.

@@T0@@Quantization error $\\lVert z - z_.src: Quantization error $\lVert z - z_q\rVert$ —

@@T0@@Bits to store index $\\log_2 K$@@T.zh:
@@T0@@存储索引所需的比特数 $\log_2 K$@@T1@@
        @@T2@@—@@T3@@
@@T0@@Bits to store index $\\log_2 K$@@T.src: Bits to store index $\log_2 K$ —

@@T0@@Drag $z$ slowly across a boundary..zh:
@@T0@@让 $z$ 缓慢地拖过一条边界。@@T1@@ 你一跨入新的单元，分配到的码与箭头
      便瞬间翻转—从连续 $z$ 到离散 $k^{\star}$ 的映射
      是分段常值的，其跳变恰好发生在 Voronoi 的接缝处。这种离散性正是
      关键所在，也是梯度需要特殊技巧（见下文）的原因。
@@T0@@Drag $z$ slowly across a boundary..src: Drag $z$ slowly across a boundary. The assigned code and the arrow flip the instant you cross into a new cell — the map from continuous $z$ to discrete $k^{\star}$ is piecewise constant, with jumps exactly at the Voronoi seams. That discreteness is the whole point, and also the reason gradients need a special trick (below).

How do you train through a hard argmin?.zh: 如何穿过一个硬 argmin 进行训练？
How do you train through a hard argmin?.src: How do you train through a hard argmin?

The snap is a non-differentiable step: n.zh:
这一吸附是不可微的一步：在一个单元内微调 $z$ 完全不会改变
      $z_q$，因此 $\partial z_q / \partial z = 0$ 几乎处处成立。这会阻断梯度
      到达编码器。VQ-VAE 使用@@T0@@直通估计器@@T1@@：
      在反向传播时，假装量化器就是恒等映射，把解码器的梯度
      直接从 $z_q$ 复制到 $z$ 上。
The snap is a non-differentiable step: n.src: The snap is a non-differentiable step: nudging $z$ within a cell does not change $z_q$ at all, so $\partial z_q / \partial z = 0$ almost everywhere. That would block gradients from ever reaching the encoder. VQ-VAE uses the straight-through estimator: on the backward pass, pretend the quantizer was the identity and copy the decoder's gradient straight from $z_q$ onto $z$.

@@T0@@Forward:@@T1@@ the decoder sees th.zh: @@T0@@前向：@@T1@@ 解码器看到真实的离散码 $e_{k^{\star}}$。
@@T0@@Forward:@@T1@@ the decoder sees th.src: Forward: the decoder sees the true discrete code $e_{k^{\star}}$.

@@T0@@Backward:@@T1@@ the gradient flows.zh: @@T0@@反向：@@T1@@ 梯度如同 $z_q = z$ 那样流动，因此编码器仍在学习。
@@T0@@Backward:@@T1@@ the gradient flows.src: Backward: the gradient flows as if $z_q = z$, so the encoder still learns.

@@T0@@Codebook loss:@@T1@@ extra terms $.zh: @@T0@@码本损失：@@T1@@ 额外的项 $\lVert \operatorname{sg}[z] - e_k \rVert^2$ 以及一个承诺项 $\beta\lVert z - \operatorname{sg}[e_k]\rVert^2$，把码拉向分配给它的编码，并防止编码器漂移离开。
@@T0@@Codebook loss:@@T1@@ extra terms $.src: Codebook loss: extra terms $\lVert \operatorname{sg}[z] - e_k \rVert^2$ and a commitment term $\beta\lVert z - \operatorname{sg}[e_k]\rVert^2$ pull the code to its assigned encodings and keep the encoder from drifting away.

@@T0@@Why discretize at all?@@T1@@ A dis.zh:
@@T0@@究竟为何要离散化？@@T1@@ 一个离散的潜变量网格就是一串整数—
      正是自回归先验（如 PixelCNN 或 Transformer）所能够建模的对象。VQ-VAE 及其
      后继者 VQ-GAN 把图像变成词元网格，从而让用于语言的那套机制也能
      生成图片。码本就是词表。
@@T0@@Why discretize at all?@@T1@@ A dis.src: Why discretize at all? A discrete latent grid is a sequence of integers — exactly what an autoregressive prior (a PixelCNN or a Transformer) can model. VQ-VAE and its successor VQ-GAN turn images into token grids so that the same machinery used for language can generate pictures. The codebook is the vocabulary.

meta.title: 向量量化（VQ-VAE）
meta.tagline: 把连续潜变量替换为一个已学习的离散码本中最近的条目
meta.summary: VQ-VAE 把自编码器的连续潜变量换成离散潜变量：每一次编码都吸附到 K 个已学习码向量中最近的一个，因此潜变量实际上只是一个整数索引。拖动编码点 z，看它跳向最近的码 z_q；拖动各个码，看它们的 Voronoi 领地如何重绘；一次性量化一整片点云，看清分配结果。结尾一节解释直通估计器如何让梯度穿过硬 argmin 回流。
highlights: 拖动编码点 z，看吸附箭头跳向 z_q —— 即最近的码向量。
拖动 K 个码向量，看 Voronoi 单元 —— 每个码的领地 —— 实时重绘。
一次量化一整片编码点云，每个按其被分配到的码着色。
读取量化误差，以及存储一个离散索引所需的 log2(K) 比特。
看清直通估计器如何把梯度从 z_q 复制回 z，使编码器仍能穿过不可微的 argmin 进行学习。
